units.source_text: 匂兵部卿亲王多年来魂思梦想冷泉院的大公主。

en.t: Prince Niou, the Minister of War, had for many years longed and dreamed for Reizei-in's eldest princess.

units.source_text: 薰中将和大公主朝夕共处在一个院内，每有机会，常得闻见她的情状，知道此女相貌的确不凡，而且品质态度高雅无比。

en.t: Lieutenant General Kaoru lived morning and evening in the same residence as the eldest princess, and whenever he had the chance, he often heard and learned about her, coming to know that her beauty was truly exceptional and that her character and bearing were incomparably refined.

units.source_text: 他想：“倘欲娶妻，但得如此一人做伴，可以终身无憾了。”

en.t: He thought, "If I were to take a wife, I could have no regret for the rest of my life if I had such a person as my companion."

units.source_text: 冷泉院宠爱薰中将，在一般事情上，对他毫无隔阂。

en.t: Reizei-in cherished Lieutenant General Kaoru, and in ordinary matters he held nothing back from him.

units.source_text: 惟有大公主的居处，防范非常谨严。

en.t: Only the eldest princess's quarters were guarded with extraordinary strictness.
This was, of course, only natural.

units.source_text: 薰中将深恐惹事，并不强求亲近。

en.t: Lieutenant General Kaoru deeply feared causing trouble and did not force any attempt to draw close to her.

units.source_text: 他想：“万一发生了意外之事，为己为人都很不利。”

en.t: He thought, "If something unexpected were to happen, it would be very harmful both for me and for her."
For that reason, he did not try to approach her.

units.source_text: 只是他生来相貌讨人喜欢，所以他对一个女子只要略有几句戏言，这女子就会动心，立刻钟情于他。

en.t: But he had been born with a charming appearance, so if he exchanged even a few playful words with a woman, she would be moved and immediately fall in love with him.

units.source_text: 因此逢场作戏的露水因缘，自然结下不少。

en.t: As a result, he naturally formed many fleeting affairs born of casual play.

units.source_text: 但他对这些女子并不特别重视，只管讳莫如深。

en.t: Yet he did not attach any special importance to these women and simply kept everything deeply hidden.

units.source_text: 这种有情还似无情的态度，反而使得女方心痒难熬。

en.t: This manner of seeming affectionate and yet almost indifferent only made the women restless and unable to bear it.

units.source_text: 于是真心爱他的人就被他吸引，有许多人上三条院去替尼僧三公主服务。

en.t: Thus those who truly loved him were drawn to him, and many went up to Sanjo-in to serve the Third Princess, who had become a nun.

units.source_text: 她们看见他很冷淡，心中甚是痛苦。

en.t: When they saw how cold he was, they suffered greatly in their hearts.

units.source_text: 但念总比断绝关系好些，也就忍受寂寞。

en.t: But thinking it was still better than severing the connection entirely, they endured their loneliness.

units.source_text: 有许多身份较高的女人，并非来当侍女，只是为了对薰中将的一点私情而在这里服务。

en.t: Many women of fairly high rank were not there to become attendants, but served there only because of their private feelings for Lieutenant General Kaoru.

units.source_text: 薰中将虽然态度冷淡，性情却很温柔，相貌也实在漂亮。

en.t: Although Lieutenant General Kaoru was cold in manner, his nature was very gentle, and his appearance was truly beautiful.

units.source_text: 因此这些女人都仿佛被他骗住，在此因循度日。

en.t: For this reason, these women all seemed to have been beguiled by him and lingered there, passing their days as they were.
